tagline.en_US: Pwndrop is a self-deployable file hosting service for sending out red teaming payloads or securely sharing your private files over HTTP and WebDAV.

description.en_US: Pwndrop is a self-hosted file hosting service designed for red teaming operations and file distribution. It allows users to securely share private files and deliver payloads over HTTP and WebDAV. The platform provides a web management interface where transfers and shared files can be configured and tracked.
